facts.fact: Agence Ecofin reports on 2026-07-17 that Greenline Technologies, a US company headquartered in Ohio, announces an initial investment of USD 150 million in the takeover and modernisation of the CAF state telecom operator SOCATEL, including a Tier 3 data centre, under a memorandum signed in September 2025.
